scenario: [LEXP.3.2]: floor, ceil, trunc and round of an Int are that Int -- it is already the largest integer <= itself, the nearest, and so on -- and [LDET.3.2.2] makes it exact. Two facts, each of which must fire: x = 2^53+1, which a round trip through double turns into 2^53, and x = INT64_MAX, which through double is 2^63, a value no int64 holds, so converting it back is undefined in C (x86-64 gives INT64_MIN, arm64 saturates). Each emits Hit keyed on its own x, so fact_count 4 = two T plus two Hit and a miss on either shows as 3. Path: builtins.c builtin_floor / builtin_ceil / builtin_trunc / builtin_round, which went through to_double for an Int -- audit finding I3; Mercury ds.eval to_integer, which returns an Int unchanged.
rules_ds:
from math import floor, ceil, trunc

schema T scope logical:
    x: Int key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where floor(t.x) == t.x and ceil(t.x) == t.x and trunc(t.x) == t.x and round(t.x) == t.x
->
    emit Hit logical d: t.x
